## TL;DR

GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.109 now exposes real `--model` ids (GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Terra, Claude Haiku 5.5, and others) plus per-model `--reasoning-effort` levels. RepoOS adds a verified catalog in `src/core/copilot-models.ts`, lists Auto tiers and those named models in the Agents picker, forwards `--model` and economical `low` reasoning on runs, enriches connectivity-test failures with the model and valid reasoning levels, and extends the budget allowlist without unpausing `github copilot`. A live probe of `gpt-6-luna` succeeded from this worktree (~0.37 credits per tiny prompt); the allowlist row stays paused for Nick to resume.

## Work and rationale

The Copilot agent had been stuck on Auto-only wiring: every run used `--model auto --auto-tier balance`, which was the right fix when `efficiency` disappeared (#1088) but left no way to pin cheap named models from the new CLI picker. Discovery used low-cost techniques first: `copilot --help` documents `--model` and `--reasoning-effort`; invalid `--model` ids return "Model … is not available" without naming alternatives; `providers` is not a non-interactive subcommand (`copilot -i "providers"` is suggested). Invalid reasoning levels fail fast with `Reasoning effort "…" is not supported for model "…"` before expensive work on some paths.

Verified model ids with one short prompt each: `gpt-6-luna` (0.37 credits), `gpt-6.1-terra` (3.7), `gpt-5.6-terra` (7.4, left out of allowlist as expensive default-class model), `claude-haiku-5.5` (0.6). Invalid: `gpt-5.6-sol` (help example outdated), `claude-haiku-5-5`. Reasoning probes: `gpt-6-luna` supports none, low–max but not minimal; `claude-haiku-5.5` and `gpt-6.1-terra` support low–max but not none/minimal; Auto tiers reject any `--reasoning-effort`. RepoOS pins `low` for named catalog models so runs stay economical and do not depend on interactive CLI defaults.

The catalog intentionally excludes Sonnet, Opus, Fusion, Gemini, Grok, and Kimi per Nick's cheap-models rule; the report lists them as seen in the interactive picker only. Allowlist models were expanded in `repoos.toml` but `paused = true` and the pause reason are unchanged — failover and dispatch still skip Copilot until `repoos agents resume "github copilot"`.

## Approaches tried

Centralizing named models and reasoning in `copilot-models.ts` while keeping Auto tier mapping in `copilot-auto-tier.ts` avoids circular imports and duplicates the #1088 pattern. `copilotNamedModelArgs` throws before spawn when RepoOS would pass an unsupported reasoning level; CLI failures are still enriched for runtime rejections. Settings labels append a compact reasoning range via `labelForModel` so the picker shows levels without a separate control (Agent has no reasoning field). Default certify/live probe pin moved to `gpt-6-luna` for a cheap named-model smoke test while engineer defaults remain Auto · Balance.

## Challenges and blockers

No machine-readable Copilot model list exists; discovery cost real credits for confirmation. This session spent multiple probe credits mapping ids and reasoning (documented above); invalid-id and invalid-reasoning checks were cheaper. End-to-end RepoOS engineer/review runs through the paused allowlist were not exercised here — that requires human unpause.

## Key learnings

Copilot validates reasoning per model, not globally; `minimal` is not universally supported even though the flag accepts it at parse time. Auto mode and named models are different surfaces: never pass `--reasoning-effort` with Auto tiers. Keeping pause while expanding `models` lets Nick adopt the catalog without immediately spending Copilot quota on dispatch.
